messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "get your prescription refilled before you run out of medicine completely"
set: ["get your prescription refilled before you run out of medicine completely", "if you lift the device away before the window is completely yellow, you may not get the full dose", "ask your doctor before stopping the medicine", "tell your doctor if you have a history of seizures before starting this medicine", "keep out of light", "keep out of the reach of children", "call your doctor before using anti-diarrhea medicine if you have watery or bloody diarrhea", "check medicine label before injecting", "start steroid medicine before levothyroxine", "call your doctor at once if you have light-headed feeling, like you might pass out", "check medicine each time you get a refill to ensure correct form", "keep out of reach of children and pets", "get emergency medical help if you have swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "child or other person using medicine without prescription", "check label of every pain medicine you take"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
